chapter.verse: Tua ciangin vanmi ngana in a pengkul tum a, vantung panin aksi khat leitung ah a kiasuk ka mu hi. Tua aksi' tungah leihawmpia a gong honna tawhtang kipia hi.
Amah in leihawmpi gong hong a, meikhuk lianpi pana meikhu pusuak bangin tua a gong pan meikhu pusuak hi. Tua gong pana meikhu hangin ni leh huihlak mialin khimzing hi.
Tua ciangin meikhu panin kauphete leitung ah pai uh a, leitunga aikamte' thahatna tawh a kibang thahatna nam, amau' tungah kipia hi.
Leitunga om lopate, singkung hingte leh singkung peuhpeuh sukha lo-in a tal tung uhah Pasian' ciaptehna gip a neilo mite bek susia dingin amaute kivaikhak hi.
Tua mite that lo-in kha nga sung gawt theih ding phalna amaute' tungah kipia a, amau' gawtna pen aikam' gawtna nam, mi khat a deh cianga kithuak nam tawh kibang hi.
Tua hun ciangin mite in sihna a zon uh hangin mu lo ding uh hi. Amaute si nuam ding uh a, ahi zongin amau' kiangpan sihna taimang ding hi.
Kauphete a melsuahzia uh pen galsim dinga kithawi sakolte tawh kibang uh hi: a lu tung uhah kham kumpi-lukhu tawh kibang dan omin a maitang uh mihing' maitang tawh kibang hi.
A sam uh numei sam tawh kibang a, a ha uh humpi ha tawh kibang hi.
Sik awmdal tawh a kibang awmdal nei uh a, a khazapna uh a ging pen sakol kaih leeng tampite galmai ah a kikhawhphei' gin tawh kibang hi.
Tua kauphete in aikam bangin mei nei uh a, tua a meite uhah gunei ling omin tuate sungah mihingte kha nga sung gimsak theihna tha om hi.
Tua kauphete in leihawmpi a uk vanmi pen amau a uk kumpi-in nei uh hi. Ama' min pen Hebrew-kamin Abaddon hi a, Greek-kamin Apollyon kici hi.
Dahhuai thu a khatna bei ta a, en un, dahhuai thu a dang nih hong tung lai ding hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi gukna in a pengkul tum a, Pasian' mai-a om kham biakpiaktau ii sakid lite pan awging khat ka za hi.
Tua awging in pengkul tawi vanmi gukna hopih a, “Euphrates gun lianpi ah a kikhih vanmi lite khahkhia in,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin mihing seh thum-ah-khat a that dingin tua hunlenai, tua hunleni, tua kha, tua kum' adinga a kigingsa vanmi lite kikhahkhia hi.
Sakol galkap phazah pen mak sawmnih ahi hi. A phazah kigen ka za hi.

Tua hi a, hih pen sakolte leh a tunga tuangte keima' muhtuam sunga ka muhdan ahi hi: amaute in meikuang cimel, sapphire cimel leh kaat cimel a nei awmdalte thuah uh a, sakolte a lu uh humpi lu tawh kibangin a kam uh pan meikuang, meikhu leh kaat pusuak hi.
A kam uh pana hong pusuak meikuang, meikhu leh kaat, hih gimpina nam thumte hangin mihing seh thum-ah-khat si hi.
Hih sakolte pen a tha uh a kam sung leh a mei sung uhah om hi. A meite un gul bangin lutang nei uh a, tua tawh mi liamsak uh hi.

Hih gimpinate tawh a silo mihing a omlai teng zong amau' khut tawh a sepkhiatte uh kisik tuanlo uh a, dawi a biakte uh ahi zongin, khuamu theilo, khuaza theilo, lampai theilo kham, ngun, sumngo, suang leh sing milim a biakte uh ahi zongin khawl tuanlo uh hi.
Amau' tualthahnate, aisannate, nulepa tatkhialhnate leh guktaknate zong kisik tuanlo uh hi.
